lines.say: Part four: Beta thalassemia.
Pichhla part ek line mein: anemia of chronic disease mein ferritin normal ya high, aur TIBC normal ya low. Theek hai?
Ab ek aur microcytic anemia, jismein iron ki koi problem nahi. Problem hemoglobin banane ki machine mein hai.
Topic eleven: thalassemia kya hai.
Thalassemia ek hereditary hemoglobin disorder hai. Hemoglobin do tarah ki chains se banta hai: alpha aur beta.
Beta thalassemia mein beta-globin chain ka gene kharab hota hai. Yeh gene chromosome 11 ke short arm par hai, point mutation ke saath. Ek baar aur: chromosome 11, short arm.
Beta chain kam bani, toh hemoglobin kam bana, toh cells chhote aur peele, yaani microcytic. Beta chain, beta chain. Theek hai?
Kin logon mein zyada? Mediterranean descent ke logon mein, aur Middle East aur South Asia mein bhi common hai.
Yaad rakhna hai: Beta thalassemia, beta-globin gene, chromosome 11 ka short arm, point mutation.
Topic twelve: thalassemia ka diagnosis.
Ab lab mein thalassemia kaisa dikhta hai? CBC mein microcytic anemia, aur MCV bahut kam, aksar anemia ke hisaab se zyada kam.
RBC count normal ya badha hua bhi ho sakta hai. Kyun? Kyunki marrow bahut saare chhote cells bana raha hai.
Iron panel? Normal. Normal, normal. Yahi IDA se sabse bada farq hai.
Blood film par target cells. Ek baar aur: target cells. Aur hemolysis ke features, kyunki kharab cells jaldi toot-te hain.
Mentzer index yaad hai? MCV ko RBC count se divide karo. 13 se kam aaye toh beta thalassemia; 13 se zyada toh iron deficiency. Ek baar aur: 13 se kam, thalassemia.
Thalassemia mein RBC count zyada hai, isliye index chhota aata hai.
Confirm kaise karein? Hemoglobin electrophoresis. Ek baar aur: hemoglobin electrophoresis. Theek hai?
Yaad rakhna hai: bahut kam MCV, normal iron panel, target cells, Mentzer 13 se kam. Confirm hemoglobin electrophoresis.
Topic thirteen: thalassemia ke teen types.
Beta thalassemia teen tarah ka hai, aur farq is par hai ki kitna gene kharab hai.
Pehla, thalassemia major: severe microcytic anemia aur target cells. Regular blood transfusion ke bina jee nahi sakte, isliye transfusion dependent.
Electrophoresis mein HbA bilkul nahi, HbF 95 percent tak, aur HbA2 5 percent ya zyada. Kyun HbF itna? Kyunki beta chain nahi, toh body fetal hemoglobin bana kar kaam chalaati hai.
Doosra, thalassemia intermedia: moderate anemia, regular transfusion ki zaroorat nahi. HbA2 4 percent ya zyada, aur HbF 50 percent tak.
Teesra, thalassemia minor, yaani trait ya carrier: mild microcytic anemia, aksar symptoms nahi. HbA2 4 percent ya zyada, aur HbF 5 percent tak.
Teeno mein ek cheez common hai: HbA2 badha hua. HbA2, HbA2.
Clinical hook: major mein marrow itna zyada kaam karta hai ki haddiyan phail jaati hain. Chehre par chipmunk facies: oonchi forehead, ubhri hui cheekbones aur maxilla. Ek baar aur: chipmunk facies.
Yaad rakhna hai: major, transfusion dependent, HbA nahi, HbF 95 percent tak. Minor, mild, HbF 5 percent tak. Teeno mein HbA2 high. Major mein chipmunk facies.
Topic fourteen: transfusion se iron overload. Ab file ka MCQ.
27 saal ki aurat, thalassemia major, regular blood transfusion par. Lambe samay se pet dard, skin par pigmentation, liver thoda bada, aur ferritin high. Kya ho raha hai?
Har unit blood ke saath body mein iron aata hai, aur body ke paas iron nikaalne ka koi raasta nahi. Toh iron jama hota hai: skin mein, liver mein, heart mein.
Ise transfusional iron overload kehte hain, yaani secondary hemochromatosis. Ek baar aur: transfusional iron overload.
Next step? Iron chelation, deferoxamine. Answer: deferoxamine. Ek baar aur: deferoxamine.
Phlebotomy kyun nahi? Kyunki patient pehle se anemic hai aur transfusion par jee raha hai; khoon nikaalna ulta hoga. Transfusion interval kam karna? Usse aur iron aayega. Theek hai?
Yaad rakhna hai: thalassemia major mein transfusion se iron overload. Treatment deferoxamine; phlebotomy nahi.
Ek baar dobara dekhte hain: beta thalassemia mein beta-globin gene kharab, chromosome 11.
Bahut kam MCV, normal iron panel, target cells, Mentzer 13 se kam; confirm hemoglobin electrophoresis.
Major transfusion dependent, HbA nahi, HbF 95 percent tak; minor mild; teeno mein HbA2 high. Major mein chipmunk facies.
Transfusion se ferritin high, pigmentation aur bada liver, toh deferoxamine, phlebotomy nahi.
Ab chhota sa quiz. Sawal suno, ruko, khud jawab socho, phir answer suno.
Sawal ek: beta-globin gene kis chromosome par hai?
Chromosome 11, short arm. Chromosome 11.
Sawal do: thalassemia aur IDA mein sabse bada lab farq kya hai?
Thalassemia mein iron panel normal. Iron panel normal.
Sawal teen: Mentzer index 13 se kam aaye toh kya?
Beta thalassemia trait. Thalassemia.
Sawal chaar: thalassemia confirm karne ka test?
Hemoglobin electrophoresis. Electrophoresis.
Sawal paanch: teeno types mein kaun sa hemoglobin hamesha badha hota hai?
HbA2. HbA2.
Sawal chhe: kis type mein HbA bilkul nahi aur HbF 95 percent tak?
Thalassemia major. Major.
Sawal saat: ubhri cheekbones aur oonchi forehead ko kya kehte hain?
Chipmunk facies. Chipmunk facies.
Sawal aath: thalassemia major, ferritin high, pigmentation aur bada liver. Treatment?
Deferoxamine, iron chelation. Deferoxamine.
Sawal nau: is patient mein phlebotomy kyun nahi?
Kyunki patient pehle se anemic hai. Phlebotomy nahi.
